people.jesus.relations: Mary is his mother. Joseph names him Jesus, as an angel told him.
people.jesus.meaning: He is born in Bethlehem, and his family settles in Nazareth. He teaches, heals, and calls twelve disciples in Galilee. In Jerusalem he is arrested and crucified. He rises and sends the eleven to teach all nations.
people.mary-mother.relations: Joseph is her husband. Matthew names four brothers of Jesus and mentions his sisters.
people.mary-mother.meaning: She is engaged to Joseph and is found pregnant by the Holy Spirit. Wise men see the child with her in a house. Joseph takes her and the child to Egypt and back. Later she stands outside with Jesus’ brothers, asking to speak to him.
people.joseph-mary.relations: Jacob is his father, and Mary is his wife. An angel speaks to him in dreams.
people.joseph-mary.meaning: He plans to send Mary away secretly, but an angel stops him in a dream. He takes her as his wife and names the child Jesus. Dreams then send him to Egypt, back to Israel, and into Galilee. The child escapes Herod, and the family settles in Nazareth.
people.john-baptizer.relations: His disciples bring questions to Jesus. Herod the tetrarch puts him in prison for the sake of Herodias.
people.john-baptizer.meaning: He preaches in the wilderness of Judea and tells people to repent. He baptizes Jesus in the Jordan. From prison he sends disciples to ask if Jesus is the one who comes. Herod has him beheaded to keep an oath made on his birthday.
people.peter.relations: Andrew is his brother. Jesus heals his wife’s mother of a fever.
people.peter.meaning: He leaves his nets to follow Jesus. He walks on the water, then fears the wind and starts to sink. He calls Jesus the Christ, then rebukes him for speaking of death. In the high priest’s court he denies Jesus three times and weeps bitterly.
people.mary-magdalene.relations: She watches with Mary the mother of James and Joses. She is not Jesus’ mother.
people.mary-magdalene.meaning: She watches the cross from afar. She sits opposite the tomb with the other Mary. After the Sabbath an angel tells them that Jesus has risen. They run to tell the disciples and meet Jesus on the way.
places.babylon.summary: Chapter 1 counts the generations before and after the exile to Babylon.
places.babylon.limits: The marker shows the city’s general location.
places.bethlehem.summary: Jesus is born in Bethlehem of Judea in chapter 2. Herod sends the wise men there. Later he kills its young boys.
places.bethlehem.limits: The marker shows the town’s general location.
places.jerusalem.summary: Wise men come to Jerusalem in chapter 2. Jesus rides in and clears the temple in chapter 21. He stands before the council and Pilate in chapters 26 and 27.
places.jerusalem.limits: The marker shows the city’s general location.
places.egypt.summary: Joseph takes the child and his mother to Egypt in chapter 2. They stay until Herod dies.
places.egypt.limits: Egypt is a whole country. The text does not say where the family stayed.
places.jordan.summary: John baptizes the crowds and Jesus in the Jordan in chapter 3. Jesus goes beyond the Jordan in chapter 19.
places.jordan.limits: The text does not say where on the river John baptized.
places.galilee.summary: Jesus begins to preach in Galilee in chapter 4. The risen Jesus meets the eleven on a mountain there in chapter 28.
places.galilee.limits: Galilee is a wide region. The marker shows only its general location.
places.tyre.summary: Jesus compares Tyre with Chorazin and Bethsaida in chapter 11. He goes to its region in chapter 15, where a Canaanite woman asks for help.
places.tyre.limits: The marker shows the city’s general location. Chapter 15 names only the region.
places.sidon.summary: Jesus names Sidon with Tyre in his warning in chapter 11. He goes to the region of Tyre and Sidon in chapter 15.
places.sidon.limits: The marker shows the city’s general location. Chapter 15 names only the region.
places.jericho.summary: Two blind men call out as Jesus leaves Jericho in chapter 20. He touches their eyes, and they see.
places.jericho.limits: The marker shows the town’s general location.
places.olives.summary: Jesus sends two disciples from the Mount of Olives in chapter 21. He teaches about the end there in chapter 24. He goes there after the supper in chapter 26.
places.olives.limits: The marker shows the mount’s general location.
places.nazareth.summary: Joseph settles in Nazareth after Egypt in chapter 2. Jesus leaves it for Capernaum in chapter 4. Crowds in chapter 21 call him Jesus from Nazareth.
places.nazareth.limits: The marker shows the town’s general location.
places.capernaum.summary: Jesus moves to Capernaum in chapter 4. A centurion asks him for help there in chapter 8. Jesus warns the town in chapter 11. In chapter 17 collectors ask Peter about the didrachma coin.
places.capernaum.limits: The marker shows the town’s general location.
places.caesarea-philippi.summary: In chapter 16 Jesus asks his disciples who people say he is. Peter answers that he is the Christ.
places.caesarea-philippi.limits: The text says “the parts of Caesarea Philippi.” The marker shows the town, not the exact spot.
places.bethany.summary: Jesus stays the night at Bethany in chapter 21. In chapter 26 a woman pours ointment on his head in Simon the leper’s house.
places.bethany.limits: The marker shows the town’s general location. This is not Bethany beyond the Jordan.

sources.minor-matthew.limits: This is Minor’s reading. Her claims about ancient social customs were not checked. Her broad claims about scholars were not checked.
